Interface ChangeNotificationProvider

@Internal public interface ChangeNotificationProvider
Database-specific implementation of JDBC change notifications.

Providers are singleton beans selected by ChangeNotificationProviderResolver from a live datasource connection during application startup. A provider translates generic listener methods into database-specific registrations and manages their lifecycle.
